_comment: File cau hinh he thong. Chinh sua truc tiep file nay khi hieu chinh, KHONG can sua code Python.
_note_pixel_calibration: Khong con can hieu chuan pixel->cm nua. Vi tri gap la CO DINH, hieu chinh truc tiep tren Arduino bang lenh Serial: SET PICKX <gia_tri>, SET PICKY <gia_tri>, roi SAVECAL.
_note_red_wraparound: Mau DO nam o 2 dau vong tron Hue (gan 0 VA gan 180) trong khong gian HSV cua OpenCV, nen mau 'R' co them 'lower2'/'upper2' de bat ca 2 dau. Cac mau con lai (G/B/Y) khong nam o vung wraparound nen chi can 1 dai lower/upper la du. Neu dung hsv_color_detector.py de hieu chinh lai mau do va thay vat mau do bi bo sot, hay kiem tra gia tri Hue do duoc (co the can chinh lai ca 'lower'/'upper' VA 'lower2'/'upper2' cho khop mau vat that.
